Assessment Question: Does the AI system collect only the information necessary for its intended purpose?
Identified Risk: Excessive collection of sensitive personal information
Recommended Safeguard: Implement data minimization and define approved data collection requirements
Reviewer Notes: Confirm that only necessary information is collected

Assessment Question: Are access permissions restricted to authorized personnel?
Recommended Safeguard: Implement role-based access control and multi-factor authentication
Reviewer Notes: Review user permissions and access records

Assessment Question: Is sensitive information protected while stored?
Recommended Safeguard: Apply encryption and establish secure data storage requirements
Reviewer Notes: Verify encryption configuration and storage safeguards

Assessment Question: Are data retention and deletion requirements documented?
Identified Risk: Sensitive information may be retained longer than necessary
Recommended Safeguard: Establish retention schedules and secure deletion procedures
Reviewer Notes: Confirm retention requirements and deletion practices

Assessment Question: Is sensitive information shared with external AI vendors?
Recommended Safeguard: Conduct vendor privacy assessments and establish contractual data protection requirements
Reviewer Notes: Review vendor agreements and data processing practices

Assessment Question: Are users informed when they interact with the AI system?
Identified Risk: Users may not understand how their information is processed
Recommended Safeguard: Provide clear privacy notices and AI interaction disclosures

Assessment Question: Are procedures established to correct inaccurate personal information?
Identified Risk: Incorrect personal information may affect AI-generated outputs
Recommended Safeguard: Establish data correction and review procedures
